en: a. having an allergy to something; having a strong dislike for something; reacting badly to a substance; very much against something
ex: She is allergic to peanuts and has to read food labels carefully.
她對花生過敏，必須仔細看食品標籤。

en: n. a strong wish to do or have something that you know you should not do or have; something that attracts you to do something bad; the act of being tempted
ex: She resisted the temptation to eat another slice of cake.
她抗拒了再吃一片蛋糕的誘惑。

en: n. a person whose job is to design buildings; a person who plans or creates something; the person who creates the main plan of something
ex: The famous architect designed the new museum.
那位知名建築師設計了這座新博物館。

en: n. an artificial waterway used for transporting boats or carrying water to crops; a tube in the body that carries something; a narrow passage; vt. to cut a canal in an area
ex: The ship passed through the Suez Canal.
那艘船通過了蘇伊士運河。

en: n. a person who is accused of a crime in a court of law; a person against whom a legal action is brought; the person being sued
ex: The defendant pleaded not guilty to all charges.
被告對所有指控都不認罪。

en: a. feeling or showing envy; wishing that you had what someone else has; showing a desire for something belonging to another person
ex: She was envious of her friend's new car.
她羨慕朋友的新車。

en: n. a vehicle that travels regularly between two places; a spacecraft that can be used more than once; the part of a loom that carries the thread; v. to move regularly between two places
ex: A free shuttle bus runs between the airport and the hotel.
有免費接駁巴士往返機場與飯店。

en: a. giving a very clear and detailed description of something, often in an unpleasant way; relating to pictures, drawings or design; shown in a diagram or picture; (of a description) clear and lifelike
ex: The writer gave a graphic description of the war.
作家對戰爭做了生動的描寫。

en: n. a kingdom; an area of activity or interest; the area under the control of a king or queen; a field of knowledge
ex: The queen ruled the realm with wisdom.
女王以智慧統治王國。

en: n. the inside part of something; the inside of a building or room; the part of a country that is away from the coast; a. on the inside; relating to the inside of a country
ex: The interior of the house is beautifully decorated.
這間房子的內部裝潢得很美。

en: vt. to open something that has been folded; to show something gradually; to explain something clearly; vi. to open out; (of events) to develop gradually
ex: The story unfolds slowly over the first three chapters.
故事在前三章緩緩展開。

en: n. a piece of paper that you can exchange for goods or services; a document that proves that money has been paid; a person who guarantees that something is true; vt. to guarantee that something is true
ex: She used a gift voucher to buy a new pair of shoes.
她用禮券買了一雙新鞋。

en: n. a set of ideas and beliefs that a group of people holds, especially in politics or economics; a system of ideas on which a political party is based; a particular way of thinking
ex: The party's ideology is based on equality and justice.
該黨的意識形態以平等與正義為基礎。

en: vt. to provide a place for someone to stay or live; to have enough space for something; to adapt to something; to do what someone wants; vi. to adapt to a new situation
ex: The hotel can accommodate up to three hundred guests.
這間飯店最多可容納三百名賓客。

en: n. the place where an event or a performance takes place; the place where a trial takes place; the location of a sports match; a specific place for a particular activity
ex: The concert venue was packed with excited fans.
演唱會場地擠滿了興奮的歌迷。

en: n. a formal written agreement between two or more countries; a formal agreement between countries to stop fighting; a contract; (old use) a negotiation
ex: The two countries signed a peace treaty after the war.
兩國在戰爭後簽訂了和平條約。

en: a. causing or able to cause death; very dangerous; (informal) extremely boring; adv. extremely or extremely serious
ex: The snake's bite can be deadly.
那條蛇的咬傷可能致命。

en: vi. to move quietly and secretly to avoid being noticed; vt. to take or put something somewhere secretly; to do something without anyone noticing; n. a person who behaves in a secretive and dishonest way; (plural) soft shoes worn for sports
ex: The boy sneaked out of the house at midnight.
男孩在午夜偷偷溜出了房子。

en: n. a thick mixture of smoke and fog that makes it difficult to see and breathe; air pollution in a city
ex: The city is covered in smog during summer.
夏天這座城市被霧霾籠罩。

en: n. very great physical or mental pain; a feeling of extreme suffering; a state of deep anxiety
ex: He was in agony after breaking his leg.
他摔斷腿後痛苦萬分。

en: vi. to form an opinion about something without having all the facts; to buy and sell shares to make a quick profit; vt. to guess something; to think about something carefully
ex: It is useless to speculate about what might have happened.
猜測可能發生了什麼是沒有用的。

en: a. (of land) unable to produce crops; (of a woman or an animal) unable to have children; having no value or interest; n. a stretch of land that is empty and unproductive
ex: The desert is a barren land with very little rain.
沙漠是降雨極少的貧瘠土地。

en: vt. to get someone to join an organization, especially the armed forces; to find new people to work for an organization; n. a person who has recently joined an organization; vi. to get new members
ex: The company is trying to recruit more engineers.
公司正在努力招募更多工程師。

en: vt. to give official permission for something; to give someone the legal power or right to do something; to approve something; to give a person official power to do something
ex: Only authorized personnel may enter this room.
只有獲授權的人員才能進入這個房間。

en: n. the place or time in which something happens; the surroundings of something; the way in which a machine is arranged to work; a place for a jewel in a ring or other jewelry; a set of knives, forks and spoons for one person at a table; the act of the sun going down
ex: The restaurant has a romantic setting by the lake.
這家餐廳位在湖邊，環境浪漫。

en: n. one of the parts of a larger machine or system; a part of something; a piece of equipment that is part of a machine; a. forming part of something larger
ex: Each component of the machine must be tested carefully.
機器的每個零件都必須仔細測試。

en: a. able to work successfully; able to be done; able to survive and grow normally; (of a plan) practical and likely to succeed
ex: The plan is financially viable and could succeed.
這項計畫在財務上可行，可能成功。

en: a. not clearly seen or understood; not well known; difficult to understand; vt. to make something difficult to see or understand; to hide something from view
ex: The meaning of the poem is obscure to most readers.
大多數讀者看不懂這首詩的含意。

en: vt. to make someone feel less worried or afraid; to tell someone again that something is true or will happen; to give someone confidence
ex: The doctor reassured her that the surgery was safe.
醫生向她保證手術是安全的。

en: a. very noticeable or surprising; attractive and likely to be remembered; (of workers) on strike; hitting or attacking
ex: There is a striking resemblance between the two sisters.
這對姊妹之間有驚人的相似之處。

en: n. a large business company; a business or organization that is a legal entity; a company made up of a number of people or companies; (British) a group of town government officers
ex: The corporation announced a plan to build a new headquarters.
該公司宣布計畫興建新總部。

en: n. an amount of something that is more than is needed; extra goods or money that are not needed; an amount left over after what is needed has been used; a. more than is needed
ex: The country has a surplus of rice this year.
該國今年稻米有盈餘。

en: n. the form of a word that refers to more than one person or thing; a. referring to more than one; consisting of or containing more than one
ex: The plural of "child" is "children".
child 的複數是 children。

en: a. available if you want it but not required; left to your own choice; (of equipment) not included as standard but available for extra payment; n. something that you can choose to have
ex: Attendance at the meeting is optional.
會議出席是可選擇的。

en: n. the most important quality or feature of something; the basic nature of something; a concentrated liquid that has a strong smell or taste; (in philosophy) what makes something what it is
ex: The essence of the problem is a lack of communication.
問題的本質是缺乏溝通。

en: n. an opening where a door is; a way to achieve something; the entrance to a house or building; a place where someone stands in a door
ex: She stood in the doorway waiting for her friend.
她站在門口等朋友。

en: n. a large stone structure with a square base and triangular sides that meet at a point, especially those built in ancient Egypt; a shape with a flat base and sloping sides; v. to arrange something in the form of a pyramid; to increase quickly
ex: The Great Pyramid of Giza was built about 4,500 years ago.
吉薩大金字塔大約建於四千五百年前。

en: n. the act of doing something, especially following a plan or order; the act of killing someone as an official punishment; the way someone performs a task; the act of performing a piece of music or play
ex: The execution of the plan was carried out flawlessly.
計畫的執行過程毫無瑕疵。

en: n. a situation in which everyone is treated fairly and equally; the value of a company's shares; the value of a property after paying off the debts on it; fairness
ex: The law aims to ensure equity in education.
這項法律旨在確保教育的公平。

en: n. fighting between armed forces; a fight between two people; the act of trying to stop something bad; vt. to try to stop something bad from happening; to fight against someone; vi. to fight
ex: Doctors are working to combat the spread of the disease.
醫生正努力對抗疾病的蔓延。
